hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null || exit 0; input=$(cat); tp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); [ -f "$tp" ] || exit 0; user=$(jq -rs '[.[]|select(.type=="user")]|last|.message.content|if type=="string" then . else (map(select(.type=="text").text)|join("\n")) end' "$tp" 2>/dev/null); asst=$(jq -rs '[.[]|select(.type=="assistant")]|last|.message.content|if type=="string" then . else (map(select(.type=="text").text)|join("\n")) end' "$tp" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$user$asst" ] || exit 0; bin/ptolemy-memory capture --quiet --user "$user" --assistant "$asst" --session "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // empty')" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
